guard: The seat side of the turn relay: a turn is yielded only once its payload was surfaced into the host session, whether the yield names the turn or takes the oldest surfaced one.; an ask relayed as a turn is rendered with the record wanted, the attempt, the previous refusal and the answer command
proveWith: pnpm mutation-proof --config extensions/connector-core/smoke/mutations/turn-intake.json   # --config resolves against the repo root, never the cwd

mutations.name: an explicit id bypasses the surfaced gate
mutations.find: if (!t.surfaced) return { ok: false, error: `turn "${t.goalId}" has not been surfaced into this session yet; nothing was seen, so nothing can be yielded for it` };
mutations.expectRed: an explicit id yields nothing the session has not been shown yet
mutations.cell: an explicit id yields nothing the session has not been shown yet
mutations.note: Ungated, a yield for a turn the session never saw is sent as if the work were done. Measured 2026-09-03: two reds, the unsurfaced-id refusal and the explicit-id handoff cell behind it (the early yield spent the turn the later explicit yield addresses); 18 passed, 2 failed.

mutations.name: an ask payload is surfaced as a bare turn
mutations.find: ask = renderAskRequest(p);
mutations.expectRed: the ask is rendered after the context: the step, every field with its kind, and the attempt count
mutations.cell: the ask is rendered after the context: the step, every field with its kind, and the attempt count
mutations.note: Measured 2026-09-03: KILLED. turn-intake.smoke: 24 passed, 3 failed Named cell red: the ask is rendered after the context: the step, every field with its kind, and the attempt count

mutations.name: the ask renderer prints the hosted-forbidden caller-chosen answerer
mutations.find: + `\nAnswer with: cotal run answer ${String(p.run)} ${String(p.step)} --value '<json record>'`;
mutations.replace: + `\nAnswer with: cotal run answer ${String(p.run)} ${String(p.step)} --by seat --value '<json record>'`;
mutations.expectRed: the answer command is the hosted form the manager accepts: run, step, value, and no caller-chosen `--by`
mutations.cell: the answer command is the hosted form the manager accepts: run, step, value, and no caller-chosen `--by`

mutations.name: the escalation renderer prints the hosted-forbidden caller-chosen answerer
mutations.find: + `\nAnswer with: cotal run answer ${String(p.run)} ${String(p.step)} --value '<json>'`;
mutations.expectRed: the escalation answer command is the hosted form too, with no caller-chosen `--by`
mutations.cell: the escalation answer command is the hosted form too, with no caller-chosen `--by`

mutations.name: a lifecycle idle is routed through the turn boundary
mutations.expectRed: a lifecycle idle mid-turn yields nothing: a compaction is not a turn ending
mutations.cell: a lifecycle idle mid-turn yields nothing: a compaction is not a turn ending
mutations.note: Measured 2026-09-03: KILLED. turn-intake.smoke: 26 passed, 1 failed Named cell red: a lifecycle idle mid-turn yields nothing: a compaction is not a turn ending. Re-anchored 2026-09-26 after the presence chain (#636/#2055) wrapped the whole body in `await this.inOrder(async () => { ... });`; the replace still delegates to setStatus unchanged.

mutations.name: the status is assigned before its presence write, so a failed write swallows the boundary
mutations.expectRed: a failed presence write does not swallow the boundary
mutations.cell: a failed presence write does not swallow the boundary
mutations.note: Measured 2026-09-03: KILLED. turn-intake.smoke: 26 passed, 1 failed Named cell red: a failed presence write does not swallow the boundary Re-anchored 2026-09-22 after a condition-clearing call was added inside the try; the replace carries that call unchanged so the mutation still isolates the ordering alone.

mutations.name: the seat discards every pull refusal in silence
mutations.find: if (!r.ok) { this.notePullTrouble(r.error ?? "refused with no message"); return; }
mutations.expectRed: a refusal that is neither is said, with the reason
mutations.cell: a refusal that is neither is said, with the reason
mutations.note: The poll runs for the life of the session and reported nothing at all, so a seat whose relay had gone quiet looked exactly like a seat that never had one.

mutations.name: every pull refusal is reported, including the boot reconciliation window
mutations.find: if (/still reconciling/i.test(reason)) return;
mutations.expectRed: the boot reconciliation window stays silent: it resolves itself
mutations.cell: the boot reconciliation window stays silent: it resolves itself
mutations.note: The manager's startup reconciliation window resolves itself and stays silent.

mutations.name: the same reason is reported on every poll
mutations.find: if (this.pullTrouble === reason) return;
mutations.expectRed: and saying it again waits for the reason to change: the poll does not become a torrent
mutations.cell: and saying it again waits for the reason to change: the poll does not become a torrent
mutations.note: A failure that persists is one fact, not one per poll interval.

mutations.name: an escalated checkpoint is surfaced as a bare turn again
mutations.find:
const escalation = renderEscalation(p);
  if (escalation !== "") return escalation;
mutations.expectRed: the escalation is rendered after the context: the question, the step, and that it was escalated to this seat
mutations.cell: the escalation is rendered after the context: the question, the step, and that it was escalated to this seat
mutations.note: The runtime submits `{ checkpoint: { token, prompt, schema, deadlineAt, escalatedTo } }` and the seat read `ask` alone, so an addressee was woken with a context block and no question, auto-yielded done at its boundary, and the second pause ran to its own expiry over a question nobody was asked. The cell that covered the relay asserted what the runtime SUBMITTED; this one asserts what the seat RENDERS.

mutations.name: MP1: remove the manager-launched guard so an unpinned session polls a manager
mutations.expectRed: T1: a session without COTAL_MANAGER_INSTANCE makes 0 manager invokes across 3 poll intervals and a turn boundary
mutations.cell: T1: a session without COTAL_MANAGER_INSTANCE makes 0 manager invokes across 3 poll intervals and a turn boundary
mutations.note: Without the guard, a directly connected session polls turn-pending every interval and at every turn boundary.

mutations.name: MP2: invert the manager-launched guard so a manager-launched seat stops polling
mutations.expectRed: T2: a session with COTAL_MANAGER_INSTANCE polls on its cadence (4 invokes across 3 intervals and a turn boundary) with --manager-instance <id>
mutations.cell: T2: a session with COTAL_MANAGER_INSTANCE polls on its cadence (4 invokes across 3 intervals and a turn boundary) with --manager-instance <id>
mutations.note: With the guard inverted, a seat launched by a manager never polls for relayed turns.

mutations.name: MP3: drop COTAL_MANAGER_INSTANCE from delegatedSeatCommand so a delegated seat does not poll its launching manager
mutations.find: return { args, env: { [MANAGED_HANDOFF_FILE_ENV]: files.handoff, COTAL_MANAGER_INSTANCE: managerInstanceId } };
mutations.expectRed: T3: delegatedSeatCommand sets COTAL_MANAGER_INSTANCE in env and the resulting seat polls (4 invokes across 3 intervals and a turn boundary) with --manager-instance <id>
mutations.cell: T3: delegatedSeatCommand sets COTAL_MANAGER_INSTANCE in env and the resulting seat polls (4 invokes across 3 intervals and a turn boundary) with --manager-instance <id>
mutations.note: Dropping COTAL_MANAGER_INSTANCE from delegatedSeatCommand leaves a delegated seat without managerInstanceId and breaks its run-turn polling.

mutations.name: MP4: re-silence no responder answered on a manager-launched seat
mutations.find: if (/still reconciling/i.test(reason)) return;
mutations.expectRed: T2: a manager-launched seat whose manager does not answer reports no responder answered once across its polls
mutations.cell: T2: a manager-launched seat whose manager does not answer reports no responder answered once across its polls
mutations.note: Re-silencing no responder answered hides a launching manager that stopped answering its launched seat.

mutations.name: MP5 (MO1b): strip COTAL_MANAGER_INSTANCE in applyHandoffManagerInstance (spec.env = { ...spec.env })
mutations.expectRed: N1a: cotal spawn handoff branch builds LaunchSpec via connector.buildLaunch and forwards COTAL_MANAGER_INSTANCE onto the launched child env (leaving a direct launch unpinned)
mutations.cell: N1a: cotal spawn handoff branch builds LaunchSpec via connector.buildLaunch and forwards COTAL_MANAGER_INSTANCE onto the launched child env (leaving a direct launch unpinned)
mutations.note: Dropping COTAL_MANAGER_INSTANCE when copying onto spec.env strips the launching manager instance id at the cotal spawn handoff boundary.

mutations.name: MO2 (MO8): delete the applyHandoffManagerInstance(spec, handoffManagerInstanceId) call at the cotal spawn handoff boundary
mutations.find:
applyHandoffManagerInstance(spec, handoffManagerInstanceId);
    artifacts = spec.artifacts;
mutations.expectRed: N1a: cotal spawn handoff branch builds LaunchSpec via connector.buildLaunch and forwards COTAL_MANAGER_INSTANCE onto the launched child env (leaving a direct launch unpinned)
mutations.cell: N1a: cotal spawn handoff branch builds LaunchSpec via connector.buildLaunch and forwards COTAL_MANAGER_INSTANCE onto the launched child env (leaving a direct launch unpinned)
mutations.note: Deleting the applyHandoffManagerInstance call site in cotal spawn leaves spec.env without COTAL_MANAGER_INSTANCE on a managed-handoff launch.

mutations.name: MP6: drop managerInstanceId from Manager.startAgent delegated launch request
mutations.expectRed: N1b: Manager.start() sets managerInstanceId from remoteAuthority and Manager.startAgent passes it in the DelegatedSeatLaunch handed to Runtime.spawnDelegated
mutations.cell: N1b: Manager.start() sets managerInstanceId from remoteAuthority and Manager.startAgent passes it in the DelegatedSeatLaunch handed to Runtime.spawnDelegated
mutations.note: Omitting managerInstanceId when Manager.startAgent calls Runtime.spawnDelegated leaves the delegated launch request without the launching manager instance id.

mutations.name: MP7: drop the COTAL_MANAGER_INSTANCE refusal from the cotal spawn handoff branch
mutations.expectRed: N2: cotal spawn with COTAL_MANAGED_HANDOFF_FILE and no COTAL_MANAGER_INSTANCE unlinks the handoff file, writes nothing, and exits 1 with the exact one-line refusal before any plane is touched
mutations.cell: N2: cotal spawn with COTAL_MANAGED_HANDOFF_FILE and no COTAL_MANAGER_INSTANCE unlinks the handoff file, writes nothing, and exits 1 with the exact one-line refusal before any plane is touched
mutations.note: Dropping the COTAL_MANAGER_INSTANCE check lets a delegated handoff child proceed past the pre-plane refusal and fail with a TypeError at trim().

mutations.name: MO4 (MP8): drop COTAL_MANAGER_INSTANCE from Manager.startAgent local spawn spec.env
mutations.expectRed: R3a: Manager.startAgent local spawn sets COTAL_MANAGER_INSTANCE on spec.env when the connector buildLaunch does not
mutations.cell: R3a: Manager.startAgent local spawn sets COTAL_MANAGER_INSTANCE on spec.env when the connector buildLaunch does not
mutations.note: Dropping COTAL_MANAGER_INSTANCE on local spawn leaves a locally spawned seat without managerInstanceId when the connector buildLaunch does not set it.

mutations.name: MP9: drop COTAL_MANAGER_INSTANCE from Manager.recoverManagedSession replacement spec.env
mutations.expectRed: R3b: Manager.recoverManagedSession sets COTAL_MANAGER_INSTANCE on the replacement spec.env when the connector buildLaunch does not
mutations.cell: R3b: Manager.recoverManagedSession sets COTAL_MANAGER_INSTANCE on the replacement spec.env when the connector buildLaunch does not
mutations.note: Dropping COTAL_MANAGER_INSTANCE in recoverManagedSession leaves a restarted seat without managerInstanceId.

mutations.name: MP10: drop COTAL_MANAGER_INSTANCE from Manager.resumePreservedAgent resumed spec.env
mutations.expectRed: R3c: Manager.resumePreservedAgent sets COTAL_MANAGER_INSTANCE on the resumed spec.env when the connector buildLaunch does not
mutations.cell: R3c: Manager.resumePreservedAgent sets COTAL_MANAGER_INSTANCE on the resumed spec.env when the connector buildLaunch does not
mutations.note: Dropping COTAL_MANAGER_INSTANCE in resumePreservedAgent leaves a resumed seat without managerInstanceId.

why: Batch B1 (2026-09-03): the ask render has its own mutant.
Batch B2 (2026-09-03): a session (re)start is not a turn ending. Claude Code fires
SessionStart on compact, clear and resume, and an auto-compaction lands mid-turn: routed
through the boundary the seat published `done` for work the model had not finished.
